# Known per-line forks in toolbelt/lint-*.sh at the guard's introduction (2026-10-22, origin/main e3713cf).
# One row per <lint file> <read variable> <reported lines>. FPL4 fails when the tree has MORE rows than listed
# (a new fork) or FEWER (a fixed fork: delete or lower its row). Never add a row for new code; write the lint as
# a Go rule (go/internal/lint) or run one awk per file instead. The baseline is empty since 2026-11-23: every
# fork it listed was removed (ledger.d/2026-10-22-r8-t22-retro-deltas.md).
